diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`null_resource.wait_for_cluster` already depends on `aws_eks_cluster.this` implicitly: its `local-exec` provisioner sets `environment = { ENDPOINT = aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint }`, so the graph lists `:resource.aws_eks_cluster.this` in both `implicit_deps` and `depends_on_deps`. The explicit `depends_on = [aws_eks_cluster.this[0]]` therefore duplicates an ordering that is already established by the attribute reference and can be removed.
